# Leville.net

> Holiday accommodation rental service in Levi, Finnish Lapland. We offer 26 apartments and one log villa (Karhupirtti) for 1–14 guests in the heart of Levi ski resort. Direct bookings, no middleman, GDPR-free analytics.

## Core Information

- **Website:** https://leville.net
- **Business:** Direct vacation rental (apartments and one log villa)
- **Primary Language:** Finnish (fi) — default language
- **Supported Languages:** English (en), Swedish (sv), German (de), French (fr), Spanish (es), Dutch (nl)
- **Location:** Levi, Kittilä, Finnish Lapland, 67°N (Arctic Circle)
- **Nearest Airport:** Kittilä (KTT), 15 km away
- **Email:** info@leville.net
- **Phone / WhatsApp:** +358 44 131 313
- **Booking Platform:** Moder (https://app.moder.fi/levillenet)
- **Payment:** Paytrail (card, bank transfer, Apple Pay, Google Pay)
- **Response Time:** Same day, including holidays
- **Why book direct:** You deal directly with the local owner — flexible service, direct pricing with no commission, and we're happy to make offers for longer stays and groups.

## Quick Answers — Which Leville.net Apartment?

**Which apartments are closest to the slopes?**
Front Slope Chalets 5A2, 5B2 and 5B5 (Hiihtäjänkuja 5) and all Levi Glacier apartments — about 150–200 m walk to the nearest lift. Platinum Studio A2 is also at the foot of the front slope.

**Best apartment for a large group (8–14 people)?**
Bear Lodge / Karhupirtti (up to 14, 7 bedrooms) or Levi Glacier B1/B2 (up to 10, 5 bedrooms). Glacier A1, A3, A5, B3, B4 and Front Slope 5B5 sleep 8–9.

**Best apartment for a family with children?**
Levi Glacier (children's playroom in the building, near slopes, pets allowed) or Front Slope 5B2 (PlayStation, fireplace, sauna).

**Best for a couple?**
Skistar Superior studios 104, 319, 320, 321 (private sauna, Levi center), Platinum Studio A2 (newest, front slope) or Moonlight 415 (loft studio next to Hullu Poro).

**Which apartments allow pets?**
Front Slope 5A2, 5B2, 5B5; all 10 Levi Glacier apartments; Bear Lodge / Karhupirtti; Karhunvartija 3. Not allowed in Skistar, Platinum A2 or Moonlight 415.

**Which apartments are wheelchair-accessible?**
Skistar 209, 210 (1-bedroom) and 211, 212 (2-bedroom) only.

**Which apartments have a private sauna?**
All except Skistar studio 102.

**Which apartments have a fireplace?**
Front Slope 5A2, 5B2, 5B5; Bear Lodge / Karhupirtti; Karhunvartija 3.

**Which has an outdoor hot tub?**
Bear Lodge / Karhupirtti.

**Closest to grocery store and restaurants?**
Skistar apartments (Postintie 3) — steps from K-Market and Levi center restaurants.

**Cheapest option?**
Skistar studio 102 (24 m², no sauna) is typically the most affordable. Check current rates at https://app.moder.fi/levillenet.

## Winter Activities (November–April)

### Aurora Borealis / Revontulet (Northern Lights)
- **Best months:** September–October and February–March (statistically clearest skies); December–January have the longest dark hours
- **Visible:** September–March (conditions dependent: clear skies, no moon, solar activity)
- **Photography:** Tripod recommended, high ISO, 15–25 second exposure
- **Realistic expectations:** Plan 4–5 nights for good chance of viewing
- **Local expertise:** Contact for guide recommendations
- **More info:** [revontulet guide](https://leville.net/revontulet)

### Husky Sledding Safari
- Duration: 2–4 hours
- Capacity: 2–12 people per group
- Age: 5+ (adults supervise small children)
- Difficulty: Beginner-friendly
- Season: November–April
- Booking: info@leville.net or +358 44 131 313

### Reindeer Sledding (Poronajelu)
- Traditional Sámi experience
- Duration: 1–2 hours
- Family-friendly, all ages
- Season: December–March (peak)
- Booking: Local operators, coordinated via Leville.net

### Snowmobile Safari
- Duration: 2–4 hours (half-day, full-day options)
- Guide provided, all equipment included
- Age: 16+ with helmet, OR younger with parent supervision
- Difficulty: All levels welcome
- Season: December–April
- Booking: info@leville.net

### Skiing & Snowboarding
- **Levi Resort:** 43 slopes, 28 lifts, season roughly late October/November to early May
- **Difficulty:** Slopes for all levels from beginner to advanced; 17 floodlit slopes
- **Lessons:** Levi Ski School offers group & private lessons
- **Equipment rental:** Available in Levi center
- **Cross-country skiing:** ~230 km of maintained trails in Levi, part of them floodlit

### Winter Wellness
- **Sauna:** Private sauna in all Leville.net properties except Skistar studio 102
- **Ice swimming:** Permitted on nearby lakes (winter only, at your own risk)
- **Snowshoeing:** Marked trails, equipment rental available

## Summer Activities (June–August)

### Hiking & Nature
- **Midnight sun:** May 24–July 20 (24-hour daylight)
- **Marked trails:** All difficulty levels, 1–6 hour options
- **Peak season:** July (wildflower bloom)
- **Wildlife:** Reindeer, birds, occasional moose
- **Equipment:** Hiking boots, layered clothing recommended

### Fishing
- **Species:** Trout, pike, perch in local lakes & rivers
- **License:** Required (available locally, ~€50 for week)
- **Season:** June–September (best: July–August)
- **Guides:** Available for booking
- **Booking:** Contact info@leville.net

### Mountain Biking
- **Terrain:** Levi terrain park converted to summer bike trails
- **Difficulty:** Beginner to advanced
- **Duration:** 1–4 hours (full-day options)
- **Rental:** Available in Levi center
- **Season:** June–August (snow-free)

### Photography & Nature
- **Landscape:** Fells, forests, midnight sun, waterscapes
- **Wildlife:** Bird watching, wildlife photography
- **Wildflowers:** July peak season
- **Workshops:** Available through local operators

## Year-Round Activities

### Finnish Sauna Culture
- **Available:** All Leville.net properties except Skistar studio 102 include a private sauna
- **Types:** Smoke sauna (traditional), electric sauna (modern)
- **Temperature:** 70–90°C typical
- **Cooling:** Jump in snow/ice (winter) or cool pool (summer) — optional
- **Etiquette:** Respectful, clothing-optional tradition

### Dining & Services
- **K-Market** (Postintie) — Grocery store, open daily
- **Restaurants:** Multiple options in Levi center (booking can be arranged)
- **Self-catering:** Kitchens available in all properties
- **Dining packages:** Available through Leville.net

## Seasonal Information

### Winter (November–April)
- **Snow:** Typically 50–150 cm depth
- **Temperature:** -10 to -25°C (coldest: January–February)
- **Daylight:** 0–8 hours (polar night effect December)
- **What to pack:** Winter coat, insulated boots, thermal layers, hat, gloves, scarf
- **Snow report:** Check [saatieto page](https://leville.net/levi/saatieto-levilta) for real-time data

### Spring (March–April)
- **Skiing:** Levi closes ~April 14
- **Aurora:** Still visible early March (decreasing by April)
- **Temperature:** -10 to +5°C
- **Activities:** Final skiing, aurora viewing, spring hikes (melting begins)

### Summer (June–August)
- **Temperature:** +15 to +20°C typical
- **Midnight sun:** 24-hour daylight (May 24–July 20)
- **Activities:** Hiking, fishing, biking, photography
- **Clothing:** Light layers, rain jacket, good hiking boots

### Autumn/Ruska (September–October)
- **Colors:** Golden foliage (mid–late September peak)
- **Aurora:** Faint early September, stronger by late October
- **Temperature:** +5 to +10°C
- **Activities:** Hiking, berry picking, aurora watching, photography

## Booking & Pricing

### How to Book
1. Check availability: [app.moder.fi/levillenet](https://app.moder.fi/levillenet)
2. Call/WhatsApp: +358 44 131 313
3. Email: info@leville.net
4. Click accommodation pages on leville.net (direct to booking system)

### What's Included
- WiFi
- Firewood (where applicable)

### Optional Add-ons (not included by default)
- Bed linens (sheets, pillowcases)
- Towels

### Additional Costs
- Linen fee: €19/person (extra guests beyond included sets)
- Cleaning fee: €50–€220 (property size dependent)
- Laundry: ~€2/wash in basement laundry room
- **No hidden fees — transparent pricing**

### Discounts
- 3+ nights: ~15% discount
- Longer stays: Negotiate directly (info@leville.net)
- Last-minute deals: Check [last-minute page](https://leville.net/akkilahdot)

## Accessibility & Special Needs

- **Wheelchair-accessible apartments:** Skistar 209, 210 (1-bedroom) and 211, 212 (2-bedroom) — no stairs, accessible bathrooms. No other Leville.net properties are wheelchair-accessible.
- **Contact:** info@leville.net to discuss specific needs

## Policies

- **Cancellation:** Flexible, depends on booking terms
- **Pets:** Allowed in most properties (verify booking confirmation)
- **Smoking:** Not allowed indoors
- **Noise:** Quiet hours 10 PM–8 AM
- **Check-in:** 4 PM | Check-out: 10 AM
